title: Is it always like this here?

fn.en: Talk about the weather right now and in general.
fn.ru: Говорить о погоде прямо сейчас и вообще.
fn.kk: Дәл қазіргі және жалпы ауа райы туралы айту.

can.en: I can talk about the weather right now.

can.kk: Дәл қазіргі ауа райы туралы айта аламын.

tip.kk: Дәл қазір → am/is/are + етістік-ing: It’s raining.

items.q: There are no clouds today. It’s ___.
In winter in Astana there is a lot of ___.

lines: Look outside! [It’s raining|It rains|It raining] and the wind [is|are|be] very strong. 🌧💨
In winter it [is|are|be] very cold here and it often [snows|is snow|snowing]. ❄️
“What’s the weather [like|as|how] with you?” — “It’s a little cloudy, but it’s [warm|warmly|a warm].” ☁️
I [am|is|are] working at home today, because it [is snowing|snows|snow]. ❄️

items.q: In Astana it often ___ in winter.
It’s very ___ today — hold your hat!
“___ the weather like?” — “It’s cold and cloudy.”
In ___ it’s hot and sunny here.

tts: Auckland has subtropical weather: it’s never very hot and it’s never very cold. It’s never snowy, for example. In summer, it’s usually sunny and the temperature is twenty to twenty-four degrees. In autumn, it isn’t hot, but it is warm — around eighteen degrees. In winter, the temperature is twelve to sixteen degrees, but it is cloudy and often rainy. In spring it is around eighteen degrees again, but it is still rainy.

acts.title: Right now in Astana
text: It’s snowing outside and the wind is very strong. ❄️💨
The temperature is minus twenty today. 🌡
In winter it’s always cold here, and it often snows.
But in summer it’s hot and sunny — thirty degrees! ☀️

items.sit: You look out of the window. Water is falling from the sky right now.
A visitor asks about winter in your city. It snows most days.
o: It often is snowing in winter.

items.sit: You call a friend in another city and want to know the weather there.
Someone asks the temperature. It is eighteen degrees.
Your colleague asks about the weather outside. The sun is out right now.
It is minus twenty and a visitor asks how it is.

write.q: Write 5 sentences: the weather right now, the temperature, and the weather in two seasons in your city.
write.model: Right now it’s cloudy and the wind is strong. The temperature is eight degrees. In winter it’s very cold here and it often snows. In summer it’s hot and sunny — thirty degrees. In spring it’s warm, but it’s often rainy.

speak.q: Look out of the window and say the weather out loud. Then say what the weather is usually like in winter.
speak.model: It’s raining and it’s quite cold. The temperature is about six degrees. In winter it’s always cold here and it often snows.
